title: List compilation specification
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $C$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, let $G$ be an initial list of gates, and let $(G',V)$ be a pair consisting of a gate list and a list of output vertices. The specification requires that $G'$ be obtained by appending gates to $G$ and be acyclic; that $V$ have the same length as $C$, with every $v\in V$ satisfying $v<n+|G'|$, and that for every input the values at the vertices of $V$, in order, equal the evaluations of the trees in $C$. It further requires $|G'|\le |G|+\operatorname{sumSize}(C)$, every output vertex to have depth at most $\operatorname{maxDepth}(C)+1$, and every appended gate to be well formed and to have at most $\max(1,\operatorname{maxFanin}(C))$ arguments.
hypotheses_covered: A list $C$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
A proposed result $(G',V)$ consisting of a gate list and an output-vertex list
For every input, output-vertex values agree in order with circuit evaluations
Each output vertex has depth at most $\operatorname{maxDepth}(C)+1$
Each appended gate is well formed and has at most $\max(1,\operatorname{maxFanin}(C))$ arguments
caveat: The payload does not define gate well-formedness, acyclicity, vertex values or depths, or the tree size, maximum-depth, and maximum-fan-in quantities, so their precise meanings cannot be checked from the supplied definitions.
